name: Indian National Congress (party)
detail: Jairam Ramesh said in April 2024 that the party has no plan for a wealth tax; the 2024 Nyay Patra manifesto was reported not to propose one. Only individual statements (Ramesh, July 2024) are recorded.

name: Sam Pitroda
detail: April 2024 remarks on an inheritance tax (US example) only; Congress distanced itself.

name: S P Tiwari (Trade Union Co-ordination Centre)
detail: Called in January 2025 for an additional 2 per cent tax on the super-rich to fund social security; the report does not say it is a tax on wealth. Check the TUCC statement.

name: Palanivel Thiagarajan
detail: Tamil Nadu minister quoted on taxing the rich and against zero-tax policy; no wealth tax named in the page found.

name: Left parties joint Budget 2025 statement (Karat, Raja, Bhattacharya)
detail: Asks for higher rates on the richer sections and corporates; income tax, not wealth. Not opened in full.

name: Kavuri Sambasiva Rao (Dr K. S. Rao)
detail: Lok Sabha speech of 2012-05-07 shared the rich should contribute 1-2% of wealth yearly; Wikidata records a death date.

name: E. Ahamed
detail: Opposed the 2015 abolition of the wealth tax in the Lok Sabha; died 2017-02-01 per Wikipedia.

name: Y. S. Chowdary
detail: Rajya Sabha 2010-08-17: asked to restore the estate duty only.

name: D. Bandyopadhyay
detail: Rajya Sabha 2011-12: estate duty and dividend tax only.

name: K. N. Balagopal (2013 speech)
detail: Rajya Sabha 2013-03-21: faulted the Budget for not taxing the super-rich and for the abolished estate duty; no wealth tax named.

name: B. Vinod Kumar
detail: Lok Sabha 2016-03-14: asked for a 3% inheritance tax only.

name: Ajit Ranade
detail: Said a wealth tax "deserves serious examination" (January 2026 interview); that the interviewer says he has argued for one is not his own statement. Re-add if his own call for a wealth tax is found.
